title: VR Stereo volumetric rendering
body: ## What problem(s) does this PR solve? - It implements Stereoscopic Volumetric Fog, so fog that renders correctly for both eyes. ## Additional information Essentially what this implements is a way of rendering the volumetric fog twice for each eye by doubling the width of the froxel buffer to allow for correct per eye sampling. **Note** that with this approach on low froxel resolution you could theoretically see the edge of the other eyes froxel buffer. However in VR you would preferably keep the froxel resolution semi-high as VR requires higher resolutions anyways and this would target higher end hardware. This implementation functionally works but hasn't been fool proof tested and there could be better ways of going about this. AI was used in implementing this, as I do not have the time nor exact knowledge currently to implement this but it is needed for my project so take it with a grain of salt, additionally it is only implemented for Forward+ and hasn't been tested on different hardware. The use of AI was to find the functions and variables that needed changing but the core idea is my solution to this problem. However the basic idea is there and could be a start point for further future development. Also I couldn't verify that this works in the master branch since it has a regression / bug that makes VR not work.
